# release-policy

> Reusable GitHub Actions workflows for releases, provenance attestations and Python
> package checks, shared by Ryan Duguid's repositories. Consumers pin a full policy
> commit. Policy checks establish release evidence, not accounting correctness.

This repository has no package installation command. `v0.1.0` is a notes-only
historical source marker, not a distributable module release.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/ryanduguid/release-policy#readme): the recorded consumer canary, release status and consumer guides.
- [Guarantees and canary evidence](https://github.com/ryanduguid/release-policy/blob/main/docs/guarantees-and-evidence.md): what the policy does and does not establish.
- [canaries.json](https://github.com/ryanduguid/release-policy/blob/main/canaries.json): each consumer's source commit, policy SHA and run identity.
